preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(s) <= 25 for s in s1) and all(5 <= len(s) <= 25 for s in s2)
preconditions.description: All strings in s1 and s2 have lengths between 5 and 25 (inclusive).
s1 and s2 are non-empty lists with at most 5000 strings each.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for s2_str in s2 if any(s2_str == s1_str[:len(s2_str)] or s2_str == s1_str[-len(s2_str):] for s1_str in s1))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of strings in s2 that are either a prefix or suffix of at least one string in s1. A string s2_str is a prefix of s1_str if s2_str equals the first len(s2_str) characters of s1_str. A string s2_str is a suffix of s1_str if s2_str equals the last len(s2_str) characters of s1_str.
